_note: Batch 21B. The 'आज का काम' line says what comes AFTER sowing. Main sowing in Sagar was mostly finished by 7 Nov 2026 (founder, from farmers). For each calendar day D and each stage, the sowers whose stage is due are those sown between D-das_to and D-das_from, clipped to sowing_dates; the line is built from that arithmetic (nothing is typed per day). Stages are the irrigation lines: they are hidden whenever the 48-hour rain level is light or higher and rain_hold is shown instead. static lines are shown every 3rd day while a stage is due, and on days when none is due; rain never hides them. Everything is seeded reviewed:false: nothing shows live until a person flips it (--draft shows it with the WARNING).

sowing_dates.basis: main sowing by 7 Nov 2026 per founder/farmer feedback; late sowing to 5 Jan per Krishisewa; KVK Sagar to confirm
